name: Meeting Follow-up Drafter
tagline: Every meeting gets a recap email drafted the same day — summary, owners, deadlines — waiting for your one-tap send or skip.
who: Operators who end each day owing five recap emails and want to batch-review drafts instead of writing them.
how: Drop the day's meeting transcripts or notes into the workspace (or wire your call recorder to export there) and the agent runs on a daily schedule: for each meeting it extracts decisions, action items with owners and deadlines, and open questions, checks prior threads you've shared for context, and drafts a short recap in your voice — under 90 seconds to read. Each draft comes to you as its own send/edit/skip question you can answer from your phone. Nothing sends without your yes.
